home.heroSub: Gaudeamus is an Italo-Scottish charity that brings Italian culture to Scotland — through theatre, language, events and a growing community from Aberdeen to Glasgow.
home.manifestoTitle: We translate Italian culture into a Scottish conversation.
home.manifestoBody: For us, Italianism is not a postcard. It is theatre performed in Edinburgh rooms and Glasgow halls; it is a workshop on Dante held in Aberdeen; it is Christmas tables shared between Italian families and their Scottish neighbours. Gaudeamus works where these two cultures meet — and where they can still surprise each other.
home.newsletterTitle: A letter from Gaudeamus, once a month.
home.newsletterBody: News, new productions, behind-the-scenes notes and the occasional Italian word we think the Scots should steal.
home.closingTitle: Italian culture is a conversation. Help us keep it going in Scotland.

about.title: A charity for Italian culture, built in Scotland.
about.lead: Gaudeamus was founded to give Italian culture a proper Scottish address. We work in the space between two cultures — translating, producing, gathering — so that Italianism in Scotland is something lived, not simply remembered.
about.missionBody: To promote Italian culture and heritage in Scotland through theatre, cultural events, educational activities and community initiatives that foster intercultural dialogue, social participation and cohesion between communities.
about.valueArtBody: Theatre, language and live performance come before everything else. Craft is our frame.
about.valueCommunityBody: We build rooms where Italian and Scottish voices meet. No silos.
about.valueAccessBody: Bilingual where we can, welcoming always. You do not need to speak Italian to belong here.
about.staffBody: A small, dedicated team of artists, educators and volunteers across Aberdeen and Glasgow. Full bios coming soon.
about.pressBody: Selected interviews, reviews and features. Updated as the year goes on.

projects.title: Work, past and present.
projects.lead: From theatre productions touring Scottish venues to cultural evenings in local halls — each project is an invitation to meet Italian culture live.

events.title: Come and see us.
events.lead: Live performances, community gatherings and cultural evenings across Scotland. If you are near Aberdeen, Glasgow or Edinburgh, there is probably something for you.
events.noUpcoming: No events scheduled at the moment. Join the newsletter and you will be the first to know.

support.title: Keep Italian culture live in Scotland.
support.lead: We are a small charity. Every donation, every ticket sold, every new member of the community helps us keep theatre on stage and evenings on the calendar.
support.wayDonateBody: We are preparing a secure online donation channel. For now, please get in touch with our finance team — we will walk you through it.
support.wayVolunteerBody: Welcome, translate, steward, build. Our productions are made by many hands.
support.wayAttendBody: Come to an event. Bring a friend. Write about us. Tag us. Word of mouth is still our best theatre.
